prompt: Night deepens over the quiet river under the full moon. Snow begins to fall, softly at first, then thickly. The willows and reeds turn white; the river bank rises and becomes a deep snow-covered slope, and the huts by the water become a row of snow-laden village houses on the hillside. The boatman pulls up his straw cape and becomes one of a few travelers trudging up the snowy slope under umbrellas. The moon disappears behind snow clouds and the sky darkens to deep grey-black. The camera slowly rises. Silent, still and beautiful. Ukiyo-e landscape print style by Hiroshige. One continuous transformation, not a fade or dissolve. Motion design for a large digital signage screen in a modern train station concourse: dynamic cinematic camera moves, layered parallax depth, crisp confident timing, and a refined, elegant Japanese atmosphere. Everything moves as if truly alive. Keep the flat ukiyo-e look: crisp ink outlines, flat colors, washi paper texture, no realistic shading.
